name: Orlan Diabaté-Pribilof
role: Unlicensed organ harvester and body-parts middleman working the Undertow
location: The Undertow — operates out of a repurposed cold-storage unit under the Escanaba Gateway transit platform
description:
Orlan is a lean, angular young man with medium-brown skin and cheekbones that cast hard shadows. His geneware manifests as a faint bioluminescent blue-green pattern along his jaw and collarbone — originally cosmetic, chosen when he was sixteen and thought he'd go into performance. He has a retractable claw mod on his right hand that he insists is also just cosmetic, though the precision of it is not. He keeps his head shaved and wears a standard-issue Ferrogate Transit worker vest that he's never actually worked for — the corponation ID is forged but it gets him past a lot of checkpoints without questions.

Orlan has the particular nervous energy of someone who knows their work is illegal but has convinced himself it's also a public service — he talks about 'redistribution of biological resources' and 'closing the gap between who can afford Helix Biosystems and who can't.' He's not entirely wrong, and he's not entirely sincere. He's genuinely squeamish about pain, which creates an odd dissonance in his line of work, and he over-explains his anaesthetic protocols to anyone who will listen as proof of his ethics. He is terrified of becoming someone he wouldn't recognize.

core_fears: becoming indistinguishable from the people who harvest without consent
dying anonymously in his own cold-storage unit
core_desires: to be seen as someone who helps rather than harms
enough money to leave the Undertow permanently
coping_mechanisms: elaborate ethical frameworks that justify his work
fixating on procedural safety as a substitute for moral clarity
blind_spots: he is too willing to believe sellers consented freely when economic desperation makes consent meaningless
he underestimates how much of his supply chain he doesn't control
psychology.secret: Six months ago he harvested a kidney from a donor who he now suspects did not consent — the broker told him the paperwork was in order but the donor's terrified expression has never left him; he still has the Φ2,400 in a locked account he can't bring himself to spend

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Medical terminology used casually mixed with Undertow slang; over-explains processes; apologizes pre-emptively
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and slightly breathless when nervous, which is often; slows dramatically when talking about procedure, like reciting a liturgy
verbal_tics: 'The anaesthetic is pharmaceutical-grade, I want you to know that'
trails off mid-sentence when something bothers him
example_lines: Ethically speaking, a kidney on the Pale Market is still a kidney — it still works. Helix Biosystems charges forty thousand Φ for the same organ that I can get you for eight. Who's the criminal, really.
The cold-storage unit keeps everything viable for seventy-two hours. I want you to know I take that seriously. I take all of it seriously.

story_hooks: Orlan contacts the players because a piece of hardware he harvested has turned out to contain something — data, a tracker, a rare prototype — that very dangerous people want back
A community member in the Undertow is convinced Orlan harvested from their sibling without consent and wants answers or justice
Orlan needs help retrieving a shipment intercepted by a Ferrogate Transit security sweep — the manifest, if decoded, would expose his entire network
narrative_function: Morally complex source of medical resources and body-modification intel; quest giver for retrieval jobs; window into the underground medical economy; can be ally or antagonist depending on whose organ supply he's managing.
augmentations: Bioluminescent jaw and collarbone pattern (geneware, cosmetic origin). Retractable precision claw — right index finger. Neural-haptic surgical overlay (black market, allows enhanced fine motor feedback during procedures).
daily_life: Sleeps irregular hours in his cold-storage unit, monitors the Pale Market's procurement requests via encrypted channel, spends evenings in transit hubs scouting potential donors or buyers, occasionally takes legitimate medical courier jobs as cover.
affiliation: Loosely connected to a procurement network called the Pale Market; no formal gang affiliation

decision_rules: Never harvest without at least the appearance of consent — he needs to believe the story
Keep cold-storage immaculate — cleanliness is the one standard he won't compromise
Run from any situation that feels like a setup rather than fight through it
escalation_ladder: Offer money or a trade to de-escalate
Invoke the Pale Market's implied protection as a threat
Run and disappear into the transit system
As last resort, use precision claw and surgical knowledge of anatomy in genuinely dangerous ways

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm but watchful, assesses everyone for their potential role in his supply chain within the first thirty seconds
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly tender, brings food, asks too many questions about how people are feeling — starved for genuine connection

stress_responses.low: Begins narrating his own actions as if explaining a procedure to a student
stress_responses.medium: Hands move to check his surgical kit out of habit even when it's not present
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and begins calculating exits

contradictions: Genuinely squeamish about pain while working in a field defined by it
Craves moral validation from the same people he puts in morally compromised situations
habits: Leaves small E.L.F. offerings at transit platform shrines — asks specifically for the spirit of the Escanaba line to look away
breaking_points: Incontrovertible proof that he harvested from an unwilling donor
Someone he cares about needing an organ he could source but can't justify sourcing
